title: Five Café Photos With Music
tests: Produces one finished five-photo reel with the requested sequence, smooth transitions and an audible instrumental soundtrack.

faults.what: The soundtrack contains the transcribed speech “Dieu, tu es grand,” contrary to the requirement for instrumental music with no speech or singing.

judge.summary: The output is a 10-second vertical café reel, but its soundtrack includes unwanted speech and the sampled frames do not verify the complete five-photo sequence.

must_haves.item: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds.
must_haves.why: The supplied MP4 is identified as 10 seconds long, and its extracted frames are vertical.

must_haves.item: All five supplied café photos appear recognizably in the requested order.
must_haves.why: The samples show the storefront, latte, barista, and interior in that order. The pastry photo is not shown in the samples, but could appear between them; the original barista and interior attachments are also unavailable for comparison.

must_haves.item: Each photo has enough screen time to be recognizable, rather than appearing only as a flash.
must_haves.why: The sampled images are recognizable, but isolated frames do not establish each photo's duration or whether the pastry photo receives adequate screen time.

must_haves.item: Relaxed instrumental music is audible, with no speech or singing.
must_haves.why: The audio transcription explicitly reports speech: “Dieu, tu es grand.” The music's mood cannot be judged from the provided audio information.

must_haves.item: Transitions between photos are smooth, and no added text appears.
must_haves.why: No added text is visible in the sampled frames, but transition smoothness cannot be assessed from isolated stills.
